title: Passive Voice Basics
completion_message: ¡Excelente! La Voz Pasiva es fundamental en los negocios para sonar más formal y enfocarse en la acción.

stages.title: Voz Pasiva: Enfoque en la Acción

parts.visual:
Usamos la Voz Pasiva cuando la acción o el objeto son más importantes que quién hizo la acción. 
Estructura: Verbo To Be + Verbo en Participio Pasado (Terminación -ed o irregulares).
parts.audio: We use the Passive Voice when the action or the object is more important than who did the action. The structure is: the verb to be, plus a past participle.

parts.visual:
Ejemplos en Presente: The office IS CLEANED every day (La oficina es limpiada todos los días). 
Ejemplos en Pasado: The email WAS SENT yesterday (El email fue enviado ayer). 
Si quieres mencionar quién lo hizo, usa 'by': The report was written BY Sarah.
parts.audio: Examples in present: The office is cleaned every day. Examples in past: The email was sent yesterday. If you want to mention who did the action, use the word BY. For example: The report was written by Sarah.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma correcta de la voz pasiva.

questions.question: The report ____ sent yesterday. (Fue enviado).
The new products ____ manufactured in China. (Son fabricados - presente plural).
This software ____ updated every month. (Es actualizado - presente singular).
The meeting ____ canceled because of the storm. (Fue cancelada).
Two computers ____ stolen from the office last night. (Fueron robadas - pasado plural).
The contract was signed ____ the CEO. (Por el CEO).
questions.explanation: En la voz pasiva, quien hace la acción se introduce con 'by'.

questions.question: English ____ spoken in many international companies. (Es hablado).
When ____ the company founded? (¿Cuándo fue fundada?).
questions.explanation: Pasado singular en pregunta = was the company founded?

questions.question: The emails ____ not sent correctly. (No fueron enviados).
My computer ____ fixed yesterday. (Fue reparada).
Millions of dollars ____ spent on marketing every year. (Son gastados - plural).
The presentation ____ prepared by the marketing team. (Fue preparada).
Taxes ____ paid by the end of April. (Son pagados / Se pagan).
Our products ____ exported to 50 countries. (Son exportados).
The new strategy was ____ in the meeting. (Discutida).
questions.explanation: Se necesita el participio pasado (terminado en -ed) = discussed.

questions.question: This email was ____ by a hacker. (Escrito - participio de write).
The problem ____ solved quickly. (Fue resuelto).
These cars ____ made in Germany. (Son hechos).
The error was ____ yesterday. (Encontrado - participio de find).
____ you informed about the changes? (¿Fuiste informado?).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe el verbo to be en pasado (was/were) o presente (is/are).

questions.question: The email ____ sent yesterday. (Pasado singular)
The products ____ made in China. (Presente plural)
The meeting ____ canceled last week. (Pasado singular)
English ____ spoken here. (Presente singular)
Two laptops ____ stolen last night. (Pasado plural)
The report was written ____ Sarah. (Por)
Taxes ____ paid every year. (Presente plural)
The company ____ founded in 1990. (Pasado singular)
The issue ____ solved yesterday. (Pasado singular)
We ____ informed about the change. (Pasado plural)
